## Overview

The region similarity module evaluates transcript contamination between
neighboring cells. The underlying assumption is that gene expression
should be consistent within a cell — deviations at the cell border
suggest transcript leakage from neighboring cells.

## Nucleus-cell overlap (IoU)

Intersection over Union (IoU) between nucleus and cell boundaries.
A low IoU indicates that the cell boundary extends far beyond the nucleus,
which is expected for transcript-based methods like Proseg v3.

```{python}
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    st.rs.match_nuclei_to_cells(n_jobs=-1)
    print(f"{method}: nuclei matched to cells")
```

```{python}
dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method", "iou"]].dropna())

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

# Distribution
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df_all,
    x="iou",
    hue="method",
    palette="Set2",
    common_norm=False,
    fill=False,
    ax=axes[0]
)
axes[0].set_title("IoU distribution (nucleus vs cell)")
axes[0].set_xlabel("IoU")
axes[0].set_xlim(0, 1)

# Median per method
medians = df_all.groupby("method")["iou"].median().reset_index()
sns.barplot(
    data=medians,
    x="method", y="iou",
    palette="Set2",
    ax=axes[1]
)
axes[1].set_title("Median IoU per method")
axes[1].set_xlabel("")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Median IoU")
axes[1].set_ylim(0, 1)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Nucleus-cytoplasm expression similarity

Expression similarity between the nucleus and cytoplasm compartments.
Higher values indicate more consistent intra-cellular expression.

```{python}
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    st.rs.similarity_nucleus_cytoplasm(n_jobs=-1)
    print(f"{method}: nucleus-cytoplasm similarity computed")
```

```{python}
dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method", "similarity_nucleus_cytoplasm"]].dropna())

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df_all,
    x="similarity_nucleus_cytoplasm",
    hue="method",
    palette="Set2",
    common_norm=False,
    fill=False,
    ax=ax
)
ax.set_title("Nucleus-cytoplasm expression similarity")
ax.set_xlabel("Cosine similarity")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Center-border and border-neighborhood similarity

```{python}
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    st.rs.similarity_center_border()
    st.rs.similarity_border_neighborhood()
    print(f"{method}: center-border similarity computed")
```

```{python}
features = ["similarity_center_border", "similarity_border_neighborhood"]

dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method"] + features].dropna())

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

for ax, feat in zip(axes, features):
    sns.kdeplot(
        data=df_all,
        x=feat,
        hue="method",
        palette="Set2",
        common_norm=False,
        fill=False,
        ax=ax
    )
    ax.set_title(feat.replace("_", " ").capitalize())
    ax.set_xlabel("Cosine similarity")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Border admixture score

The border admixture score quantifies how much the cell border expression
is explained by a mixture of the cell center and its neighborhood,
rather than the center alone. A high score indicates contamination.

```{python}
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    st.rs.border_admixture_score()
    print(f"{method}: border admixture score computed")
```

```{python}
dfs = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs.copy()
    obs["method"] = method
    dfs.append(obs[["method", "border_admixture_score"]].dropna())

df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

sns.kdeplot(
    data=df_all,
    x="border_admixture_score",
    hue="method",
    palette="Set2",
    common_norm=False,
    fill=False,
    ax=axes[0]
)
axes[0].set_title("Border admixture score distribution")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Border admixture score")

medians = df_all.groupby("method")["border_admixture_score"].median().reset_index()
sns.barplot(
    data=medians,
    x="method", y="border_admixture_score",
    palette="Set2",
    ax=axes[1]
)
axes[1].set_title("Median border admixture score per method")
axes[1].set_xlabel("")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Median score")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Summary table

```{python}
rows = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs

    rows.append({
        "Method": method,
        "Median IoU (↑)": round(obs["iou"].median(), 3) if "iou" in obs else None,
        "Median nucleus-cytoplasm similarity (↑)": round(obs["similarity_nucleus_cytoplasm"].median(), 3) if "similarity_nucleus_cytoplasm" in obs else None,
        "Median center-border similarity (↑)": round(obs["similarity_center_border"].median(), 3) if "similarity_center_border" in obs else None,
        "Median border admixture score (↓)": round(obs["border_admixture_score"].median(), 3) if "border_admixture_score" in obs else None,
    })

pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Method")
```
